description: This file defines a Zustand-based React store for managing resources state, including list data, pagination, filters, and real-time updates. It interacts with external services and utilities for resource fetching and logging.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the current query filter and resets the page to 1.

methods.name: setProvider
methods.description: Sets the current provider filter and resets the page to 1.

methods.name: setPageSize
methods.description: Sets the number of items per page and resets to page 1.

methods.name: fetchList
methods.description: Fetches a list of resources from the external resourcesService based on current filters and pagination, updating store state accordingly.

methods.name: onRealtimeInsert
methods.description: Inserts new resources at the top of the list, ensuring no duplicates by ID.

methods.name: onRealtimeUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing resource in the store if it matches the current filters.

methods.name: onRealtimeDelete
methods.description: Removes a resource from the store if it exists.
